questions: Did s-bend off-track exits stay at 1 of 20 or fewer at wheel_track 0.17, compared with 1 at 0.16?
Did s-bend max_error stay at or below 0.027, or did the wider track make bends sluggish?
Did steering_oscillation stay below about 0.4 on the oval and s-bend, and did the oval finish stay at 1.0?
Is the track-width gain still positive in score (above 661.5), or has it saturated?
Is slalom still 0 of 20 with line_loss near 1.2? If so, should the next test be kd 0.8 at the best track width?

intent: Change one variable from the best known design (iteration 8, wheel_track 0.16, score 661.5): raise wheel_track to 0.17 m, keeping kp 4.0 and sensors at y 0.08 with 16 mm footprints on the ±0.024 m span. Body, wheels and mass are unchanged. This continues the monotone track-width trend, which R1 specified as the next step. Expected: s-bend off-track exits at 0 to 1 of 20, s-bend max_error at or below 0.027, s-bend control_effort at or below 8.2, oval finish at 1.0, and steering_oscillation below 0.4. Revert to wheel_track 0.16 if s-bend exits rise above 1, max_error rises above 0.030, or the oval finish falls below 0.85.
learning: Track width at y 0.08 with kp 4.0 has improved the score monotonically from 0.10 to 0.16 (496.4, 561.6, 628.6, 661.5), with s-bend off-track exits falling from 15 to 1. The sweep is flattening, so 0.17 is the last step in this direction before a separate test is needed. Slalom remains 0/20 at every geometry and is not addressed by track width. If the 0.17 result is flat, the next test is kd 0.8 at the best track width, as R1 proposed. Evidence from the sensor span, footprint and lookahead sweeps does not support changing those again.
rationale: Iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.16, sensors at y 0.08, 16 mm footprints, x ±0.024 m) scored 661.5, the best so far. The track-width sweep at y 0.08 is now monotone: 0.10 gives 496.4, 0.12 gives 561.6, 0.14 gives 628.6 and 0.16 gives 661.5. S-bend off-track exits fell to 1 of 20 (finish 19/20), max_error fell to 0.027, and control_effort fell to 8.2. The oval stayed at 20/20 with oscillation 0.21, and s-bend oscillation was 0.285, under the 0.4 gate. R1's gate for the next step is met: s-bend exits are below 4, max_error is at or below 0.034, and oscillation is under 0.4. I am therefore following R1's first requested change and moving to wheel_track 0.17, keeping everything else fixed at iteration 8 values so the result isolates track width. The gain per step is shrinking (+67 at 0.14→0.16, +33 at 0.16→0.17 expected), and the s-bend is nearly saturated, so the expected gain is small: a score around 670 to 685, with max_error near 0.025 and s-bend exits at 0 to 1. Slalom has been 0/20 at every geometry, with line_loss about 1.05 to 1.2 and max_error about 0.063. It is not the target of this step; the sensor span, footprint and lookahead were already tested without fixing it. The unseen final track is a different shape, so I will not treat the s-bend gain as proof of general performance. Risk: a wider track could make the robot sluggish on tight bends. If s-bend exits rise above 1 of 20, max_error rises above 0.030, or the oval finish falls below 0.85, revert to wheel_track 0.16 (iteration 8).
